# Tom the Vacuum Man — Vacuum Cleaner Services, Leicester

> Family-run vacuum cleaner repair service in Leicester, UK. Father & son, over 35 years on the bench. Historically traded from a shop at 315 Aylestone Road (LE2 7QL); the building has been sold, so the service is going mobile across Leicester and Leicestershire. Repairs, servicing, spares, bags, filters and motors for most domestic vacuum brands, plus spares for washing machines, tumble dryers and cookers.

## Social
- [TikTok @tomthevacuumman](https://www.tiktok.com/@tomthevacuumman): Workshop repairs, rescues and occasional rants about bagless models.
- [YouTube @tomthevacuumman](https://www.youtube.com/@tomthevacuumman): Long-form repair and restoration videos.

## Services
- Vacuum repair & servicing — Dyson, Henry / Numatic, Sebo, Miele, Vax, Shark, Kirby, Electrolux, Hoover, Bosch.
- Replacement parts — belts, brush-bars, motors, cables (rewind and flex), filters (HEPA, pre-motor, exhaust), hoses, wands, tools.
- Bags & consumables for virtually every domestic vacuum bag type.
- Spares for washers, tumble dryers and cookers — anything with a motor.

## Service area
- Leicester (LE1–LE9) and surrounding Leicestershire towns: Wigston, Oadby, Blaby, Glenfield, Birstall, Syston, Enderby.
